questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 301, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.

questions.question: Who has achieved the 150 runs and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Lanette Pienaar or Anneke Bosch?
questions.explanation: Lanette Pienaar: 2 times. Anneke Bosch: 1 times.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Matches as Captain' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 43.

questions.question: At which ground did Alicia Farinha record their career-best innings (45, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2013/03/09.

questions.question: Carmen Nagel set a database record (19/20 season, T20) with a value of 131.00. Which record is it?
options: Best Bowling Figures in an Innings
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Best Batting Average', held by Carmen Nagel.

questions.question: South Africa Women played their first ODI in August 1997, 25 years after their last Test before an extended absence from international cricket. Who was the opponent, and where was it played?
questions.explanation: South Africa's first ODI after readmission to international cricket was against Ireland at Stormont, Belfast, on 5 August 1997.
